summary: 2026 FIA WEC season, LMGT3 (#61 and #79 Mercedes-AMG GT3 Evo). Iron Lynx carries no title sponsor: its WEC entrants are named 'Iron Lynx' and no front-of-car commercial sponsor is documented. All entries are the partners the team itself publishes on ironlynx.com, mirrored as 'partner' placements (the Ducati MotoGP pattern): Blaupunkt (partner since 2025, per the team's own 31 Aug 2026 news), Goodyear (also the WEC's exclusive LMGT3 tyre supplier), Ravenol, Carraro 1927, Italian Gesture, OMP, Prisma Electronics, Setup Wizzard, Control (cntrl.io telemetry) and PlasticFree (anti-plastic charity, likely not a paid sponsor). Car-livery logos do not fit the schema and are not mapped.
